svg.title: Power line worker — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as power line worker, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A utility pole crossarm supports two separated collared insulators joined by a gently sagging cable. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
